proved_implication: For B=X^T M Y, sup_t P(|B-t|<=u) is bounded by the same centered small-ball probability for cube uniforms. Consequently sup_t E|B-t|^-1/2 <= K_HP ||M||_HS^-1/2 with K_HP=C[e^c+2 C''(c+1)e^-c] from Hu-Paouris source constants. Hence X^T M Y+aW^2+dW+c has density cap K_HP/sqrt(|a| ||M||_HS).
